description: Find the LinkedIn top voices on a topic, as one of the organization's connected accounts. Send query.account_id and query.topic, and query.limit up to 50. Each one comes back with a score out of 100 and the parts it is made of - reach (how many follow them), resonance (what a post of theirs earns), conversation (how much of that is comments rather than taps) and cadence (how regularly they publish) - along with the figures behind them and whether this organization already watches them. LinkedIn's own Top Voice badge is reported as badge when the profile exposes it; badge null means it did not say, never that there is none. -- MakeHybrid API plan, GET /linkedin/topvoices, group campaigns.

query.description: Optional query-string parameters, e.g. {"limit":"20","cursor":"..."}. Values are coerced to strings.
